predictions.claim: Six of the ten site laws are PROVED by the new proof class coercion_guard, each proof calling a core lemma through the imported core library: L_sort_site_rollup_441_b4cd5068 (revertBatch let p = idx - lfi, a window offset, after the require idx > lfi at :441), L_sort_site_rollup_485_495_b4cd5068 (challengeState effect win offset idx - lfi, after lfi < idx at :476), L_sort_site_rollup_644_660_e68daf06 (finalizeBatch effect idx - 1, the checked deletes at :657-660, after idx >= 1 at :636 passed), L_sort_site_def_w_b4cd5068 (def w: idx - lfi under in_win, i.e. idx >= lfi), L_sort_site_def_bvh_at_6126d1f1 and L_sort_site_def_bvh_at_e064679d (def bvh_at: idx - lci and (idx - lci) - 1, both under !(idx <= lci)). Basis: in each, a condition the evaluation has already passed implies minuend >= subtrahend by one Nat lemma (gt->le, lt->le, ge->le, and_left then ge->le, not_le->le, not_le->1<=sub), true in every state, so no reachability argument is needed. Bend probes on a toy machine (scratch, not Morph) checked this proof shape, including the equation-carrying match on a guard's Bool, under bend and BendTT.

Two site laws stay UNKNOWN, with a bounded record and no witness at any entry point: L_sort_site_l1messagequeuewithgaspriceoracle_325_f89daf17 (finalizeBatch btot - bn, SIdx[queue] sign site; true on reachable states because every window entry has tot = parent tot + n >= n, but no guard implies it) and L_sort_site_def_lci_356891e4 (def lci: (lfi + len(win)) - 1, reached from the seven actions that compute lci; true because the window is never empty, which no guard states). No witness exists, coercion_guard does not apply, and reach_invariant does not take a law with an Act binder; BUILD_PLAN I15 risks: an unguarded site without a witness stays UNKNOWN, with its bound (I40 revisits).

The :363 site (W + cstart - t, SDur, sign) yields ONE law, L_sort_site_rollup_363_1fc7f88a, with entry points commitBatch, commitBatchWithProof and commitState, each hit at its realization check (the facts' require !inch || t <= W + cstart, reason panic:0x11, at guards[23], guards[27] and guards[22]); it is REFUTED with one Bend-checked counter-law witness per entry point, and each witness replays on the real code at the pinned commit with every prefix step succeeding and the entry point reverting with Panic(0x11) raised at Rollup.sol:363 (located by solc's source map in a Foundry debugger dump). Scored: one law with exactly these three entry points and hits, a checked witness for each entry point, and each replaying with a Panic(0x11) located at Rollup.sol:363. Not scored (context, decided by the search): the commitBatch entry point's refutation mirrors the M1 witness of L_sort_remaining already recorded in results/M1, and the expected witness shapes are: commitBatch after [commit 1, challenge 1, wait 11] (the M1 L_sort_remaining shape), commitBatchWithProof after [commit 1, challenge 1, wait 21] (rollup delay passed), commitState after a prefix that also commits and reverts a later batch so that a blob hash is stored for the next index (5 actions, found by the neighbourhood stage S3 around the commitBatch witness). This localizes O27 to a site, where L_sort_remaining was stated over a reason code.

Contrary to the plan's expectation (':636 PROVED by coercion_guard'), the :636 site (finalizeBatch idx - 1 in finalizedStateRoots[_batchIndex - 1]) is REFUTED: the facts' require idx >= 1 (reason panic:0x11, span :636) models the real code's own checked subtraction, so the obligation is evaluated before it (rule R8), and finalizeBatch with idx = 0 from a state with lfi = 0 (s0) passes every earlier require and reaches it with 0 < 1; on the real code finalizeBatch(genesis header) reverts with Panic(0x11) raised at Rollup.sol:636, before the 'incorrect batch index' check at :643. The witness is found by the boundary variants of stage S1 (idx := v - 1 of the policy's idx = lfi + 1). The guard-implied idx - 1 site is the finalizeBatch effect site :644-660 (I15-P1). The finding is benign (the call reverts either way, with another reason) but it is a reachable underflow.

Under MUT2 (spec/M1/mutations.json MUT2_cwp_no_underflow_check: commitBatchWithProof's :363 require := true), re-derived from the mutated facts with their regenerated sorts: the :363 law is still generated under the same id with entry points commitBatch and commitState, and the derive diff against the committed laws/M2 lists commitBatchWithProof as lost from it (and nothing gained); a new law L_sort_site_rollup_360_364_1fc7f88a (commitBatchWithProof's now unchecked W + cstart - t, span :360-364, hit at its occurrence guards[28]) is added with that single entry point. Run on the mutated model, the :363 law is REFUTED through commitBatch and commitState, one checked witness each, and the new law is REFUTED through commitBatchWithProof: the SORT-site law catches what the dropped require modelled.

Coherence obstructions (rule R11: a guard kappa => rho whose rho constrains the action's inputs must not read a writer-labelled register the action does not write) appear exactly at the three enq_first call sites of the l1msg delay guard !(ef + D < t) || n > 0 and nowhere else: commitBatch guards[5] (for the require guards[6]), commitState guards[10] (guards[11]) and commitBatchWithProof guards[4] (guards[6]); each passes qlen (Idx[queue]_wcf8ad7dc, writers {sendMessage}) and qpend (Idx[queue]_fin, writers {finalizeBatch}) into enq_first, while rho (n > 0) constrains the commit family, which advances Entry.tot (Idx[queue]_inc); each lists constrains = [n]. The :363 require's rho reads no input, and setPause's kappa reads only Bool registers, so neither yields one (O16/O33 coherence, whitepaper §7.8).
